products.title: Medium Structure

products.title: Large Structure

products.title: Volumetric Balloon
products.description: Promotional inflatable balloon with material study, render levels and volume read — from untextured model to final presentation for campaigns or retail.

products.title: Inflatable Dinosaur

products.title: Want to learn how to model your own inflatables?

nestlab.title: NestLab
nestlab.description: Nesting and raw-material consumption software for footwear — sheet layouts, yield and waste to support cost formation.
nestlab.introBody: NestLab estimates real material use from how pieces nest on the sheet. Import DXF, assign materials, nest the layout and review yield and waste — so pricing can follow production data, not theoretical area alone.

simuladorEducacional.title: Educational quiz simulator
simuladorEducacional.description: Multiple-choice practice tests by country, grade, and subject — with scores, explanations, and history stored on your device.
simuladorEducacional.introBody: Practice questions aligned to the school year. Mistakes matter: each try reinforces what you know and highlights what to study next.

jogoDamas.title: Checkers game
jogoDamas.description: Brazilian draughts — capture, crown kings, and play two-player or vs the computer.
jogoDamas.introBody: Checkers build strategy, attention, and planning — skills for kids and adults. Slow down, think a move ahead, and enjoy learning.

jogoXadrez.title: Chess game
jogoXadrez.description: Classic chess to learn and play — check, castling, en passant and promotion, two-player or vs the computer.
jogoXadrez.introBody: Chess develops logic, patience, and decision-making. Every game is focus practice — and a reminder to think before you move.

quimicaLab.title: QuimicaLab
quimicaLab.description: Educational virtual chemistry lab — interactive periodic table, substances and reactions to explore hands-on.
quimicaLab.freeNotice: Free to use on this site · proprietary software by Sem Talento Studio
quimicaLab.termsFree: Free use of the web version on this site only, for educational and demonstration purposes.
quimicaLab.termsProprietary: The software, source, builds, and QuimicaLab brand are proprietary to Sem Talento Studio. No redistribution, mirroring, or republishing without written authorization.
quimicaLab.termsSponsor: Sponsorship placements on this page are available under a commercial agreement.
quimicaLab.termsDesktop: Installable (.exe / desktop) builds and institutional licenses are negotiable — not included in free online use.
quimicaLab.termsDisclaimer: Educational tool provided “as is”. It does not replace a supervised physical lab or professional teaching guidance.
quimicaLab.introBody: Explore chemistry concepts safely, without a physical lab. Interact with substances, reactions, and the periodic table in an educational way.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: The studio born to unite ideas and turn them into solutions.

intro.lead: If you made it here, you're looking for something more.
intro.body: Our work is to help draw out that desire and turn it into a solution — whether in concept, design, product, or even a tool that doesn't exist yet.

origin.title: Why we exist
origin.body: Sem Talento Studio was born from the need to extract and unite different things in the field of ideas — intentions, references, skills, desires not yet fully formed — and turn them into product or solution. We didn't start from a fixed niche: we started with simple questions:
origin.question2: How do we give it real form?

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Listen to what's behind the request. Desire rarely arrives ready — it comes fragmented, intuitive, sometimes unnamed.

unite.title: Unite
unite.description: Connect disciplines that don't usually talk: footwear and code, physical product and digital experience, concept and manufacturing.

transform.title: Transform
transform.description: Carry it through to something usable — a 3D model, a prototype, a website, a tool that didn't exist yet.

fields.title: What we connect
fields.subtitle: Different fronts, one way of thinking.
fields.footwear: Footwear design — from concept to model ready to evolve
fields.product: Product design — objects, volumes and production feasibility
fields.3d: 3D modeling & CAD — precise form before render or factory
fields.web: Websites and platforms — digital presence with purpose
fields.software: Digital tools — solutions that didn't exist yet
fields.education: Education — free tools for hands-on learning

philosophy.title: How we think
philosophy.p1: We believe design isn't decorating a ready-made idea — it's giving shape to something still being sought.
philosophy.p2: That's why our work spans footwear, industrial objects, websites, software and education: they're expressions of the same impulse — taking what's in someone's head and putting it in the world in a way that works.

educationRole.title: Our role in education
educationRole.body1: Education belongs to the same studio impulse: extract a real need — learning with clarity, without unnecessary barriers — and turn it into something usable.
educationRole.body2: Labs, games, draw-and-color sheets and quizzes are part of our social role: bringing knowledge closer to anyone who wants to study, with open access and the same care we put into a product or a website.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: How we handle your data on this site.
privacy.intro: SemTalento Studio respects your privacy. This page explains in plain language what we collect and why.
privacy.collectBody: Via the contact form: name, email, subject and message — only to reply to you. Data goes to our contato@ mailbox (Zoho Mail). We do not sell lists and do not require an account to use free tools.
privacy.toolsBody: Some features (such as the quiz simulator) may store history only on your device. That data does not go to our servers. Clearing browser data deletes that history.
privacy.contactBody: To request access, correction or deletion of data sent via the form, email
